_comment: This figure contrasts the authors' full-corpus snapshot of the benchmarking
records with the smaller subset that was public at the time of that snapshot.
Neither series is recomputable from the files shipped here: the full corpus is
the authors' private snapshot (supplement Section S-VI), and the 202-architecture
released subset is a historical state of the public repository that the current
records under results/v83/ have since superseded.  The four plotted numbers are
therefore carried here, exactly as in the published figure, in the same way that
export_gap_values.json and im100_checkpoint_gap_values.json carry their histograms.
The figure appears in neither main.tex nor supplementary.tex; it is kept only for
traceability.  Series order: [best mode changes with device, architecture-only
